kill_switch.description: true = block every cloud-capable AI call (S3; S2/S4 cloud side). Device and rules paths keep working; Judge Mode uses CACHED samples.

routing_policy.description: Routing by payload class. The client merges it with a hard floor: S0/S1 can never be loosened.

adversary_model.description: Pass A/B/re-attack model. Exact id, never -latest. flash-lite since D-159 (gemini-3.8-flash overloaded on the free tier).

adversary_thinking_level.description: LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH. MINIMAL is a 400 on gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-4-*.

explain_cloud_model.description: Cloud side of S2 (explainer) and S4 (Judge Mode device jobs).

prompt_versions.description: Full prompt ids. Selects among versions BUNDLED in the app; unknown ids fall back to the bundled v1. Prompt text never comes from Remote Config.

grounding_enabled.description: Run pass A (Search-grounded notes). false = pass B only.

data_tier.description: paid|free. Drives the consent copy; free forces grounding off.

daily_adversary_cap.description: Attack runs (A+B pair = 1) per installation per LOCAL day, client-side. Keep project-wide grounded queries well below 1,500/day. Clamped 1-200.

bands_m.description: Distance-band upper bounds in metres, strictly increasing. street/neighbourhood/district are locked to 250/1000/5000 (D-77); only city/country (placeholders) are tunable.

auto_mask_types.description: Nano pre-screen clue types masked in Standard mode when severity is high and the clue is located by OCR (faces, vault hits and regex hits are always masked). Subset of CLUE_TYPES.

strict_mode_default.description: Strict mode masks every flagged clue before the cloud sees anything.

fuzzy_threshold.description: Normalised Levenshtein similarity for text-to-vault matches (clamped 0.6-0.98).

face_min_confidence.description: Face score that masks (Tier-0) AND blocks (gate). One value for both (clamped 0.2-0.6).

mask_pad_ratio.description: Total mask padding as a fraction of box size (clamped 0-0.5); minimum 4 px.

cloud_image_max_px.description: Longest side of the redacted JPEG sent to the cloud (clamped 768-2048).

nano_image_max_px.description: Longest side of the JPEG given to Gemini Nano. Clamped 256-768 in code (floored first; D-98).

ocr_max_px.description: Longest side of the Tier-0 Tesseract canvas: a downscale of the <= 2048 px master, never upscaled (SPEC D-20). Clamped 800-2048 (D-83).

judge_cached_fallback.description: When the live adversary is unavailable in Judge Mode, replay the recorded pass-B JSON for the synthetic sample (badge CACHED).

extension_enabled.description: Stretch: accept files from the Chrome extension.

adversary_seed.description: UNVERIFIED experiment: if non-zero, cast-send generationConfig.seed. 0 = do not send.
